label: Behavior
description: What the animal is doing — documentary shots are subject x behavior x habitat. Each entry is a real observable moment.

items.name: hunting-stalk
items.text: in a low hunting stalk, belly to the ground, each foot placed and frozen before the next, eyes never leaving the target

items.name: chase-sprint
items.text: at full sprint in pursuit, spine coiling and releasing with every bound, dust hanging in the wake

items.name: feeding-young
items.text: feeding its young, head bent to the smallest one, pausing between mouthfuls to scan the horizon

items.name: grooming
items.text: mid-grooming, working methodically down one limb, utterly absorbed and unhurried

items.name: territorial-display
items.text: in full territorial display, made as large as possible — coat, crest or plumage erected, stance square to the rival

items.name: courtship-dance
items.text: deep in courtship display, movements exaggerated and rhythmic, colors at their seasonal brightest

items.name: migration
items.text: on migration among thousands moving in one direction, a river of bodies following the old route

items.name: play-fight
items.text: play-fighting with a sibling, mouths wide but grips soft, the roles of chaser and chased trading every few seconds

items.name: drinking-waterhole
items.text: drinking at the waterhole in quick sips, head rising between each to check the banks, reflection doubling every posture

items.name: sleeping-curl
items.text: asleep in a tight nose-to-tail curl, flank rising slowly, one ear still turning toward small sounds

items.name: alert-freeze
items.text: frozen mid-step in high alert, weight balanced over still feet, ears cupped and eyes locked on something beyond the frame

items.name: carrying-prey
items.text: carrying limp prey in a careful jaw grip, head held high to keep it clear of the ground, moving with quiet purpose

items.name: dust-bath
items.text: rolling shoulder to shoulder in a dust bath, the kicked-up cloud hanging golden, coat loaded with fine grit

items.name: nest-building
items.text: building a nest strand by strand, testing each placement and discarding anything that fails the shake test

items.name: flehmen
items.text: pausing in a flehmen grimace, upper lip curled high to draw a scent across the roof of the mouth, eyes half-closed

items.name: mud-wallow
items.text: sunk blissfully in a mud wallow, rolling until every flank is armored in wet clay against sun and biting insects

items.name: stotting
items.text: stotting — bouncing stiff-legged high off all four feet at once, an extravagant show of fitness aimed at the watching predator

items.name: shake-dry
items.text: shaking dry in one accelerating spiral from nose to tail, water sheeting off in a backlit halo

items.name: yawn-threat
items.text: in a slow deliberate gape that is threat rather than tiredness, every tooth shown to the rival at leisure

items.name: caching-food
items.text: caching food with theatrical caution, pressing the prize into its hiding place and glancing around before covering it

items.name: scent-marking
items.text: scent-marking a boundary post, cheek and flank dragged deliberately along the wood, then a long nose-down read of every visitor that came before

items.name: mutual-grooming
items.text: grooming a companion in the places neither can reach alone, nape and brow worked over patiently, both sets of eyes half-closed

items.name: sunning
items.text: sunning broadside to the low sun to warm up, body flattened and angled for maximum surface, eyes slitted but still watching
